subject.title: A stationary camera invents depth from no baseline

capsule.title: A stationary camera invents depth from no baseline
capsule.summary: During hover, repeated camera bearings contain no translation baseline for triangulation. MSCKF position error becomes thirteen times worse than dead reckoning.
capsule.trigger: Hold the platform in hover while continuing to feed image bearings and inertial measurements to the estimator.
capsule.observed: MSCKF reaches 1.202 m error versus 0.094 m dead reckoning and rejects 12,086 features for parallax or triangulation failure.
capsule.invariant: A feature may constrain position only when the observing camera poses provide enough translational parallax for stable depth.
capsule.fix: Reject underconstrained features, expose the observability loss, and require a motion plan that excites translation before claiming VIO improvement.

timeline.title: Freeze translation
timeline.detail: The camera rotates negligibly and observes the scene repeatedly from the same position.

timeline.title: Lose depth observability
timeline.detail: Bearing rays do not intersect with a useful baseline; triangulation becomes ill-conditioned.

timeline.title: Reject twelve thousand features
timeline.detail: The benchmark records the rejected geometry and the resulting position error.

timeline.title: Make motion part of the contract
timeline.detail: The lab refuses to generalize figure-eight accuracy to hover.

limits: The benchmark uses synthetic feature tracks; a real front end adds correspondence and calibration failures.
